# GitRunByKaru (grbk)

> Run conventional public GitHub repositories and local workspaces locally in seconds with a single command. Zero config friction.

## Summary
GitRunByKaru (`gitrunbykaru` or `grbk`) is a command-line tool, runtime engine, and Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that automates cloning, framework detection, dependency installation, `.env` synthesis, and application execution.

## Installation
Requires Node.js 18+.

```bash
npm install -g gitrunbykaru
```

## CLI Usage
Run any GitHub repository:
```bash
gitrunbykaru https://github.com/user/repo
# or short alias:
grbk https://github.com/user/repo
```

Machine-readable JSON mode:
```bash
gitrunbykaru https://github.com/user/repo --json --no-open
```

## AI Agent Integration (MCP)
GitRunByKaru includes an MCP server compatible with Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code, and Windsurf.

### MCP Configuration:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "gitrunbykaru": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "gitrunbykaru-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Available MCP Tools:
- `gitrun_remote({ repoUrl, preferredPort })`: Shallow clones remote GitHub repository to OS /tmp, prepares .env, installs dependencies, and launches development server.
- `gitrun_local({ workspacePath, preferredPort })`: Runs local workspace in-place without deleting files.
- `gitrun_stop({ sessionId })`: Gracefully stops the process tree by session ID.

## Supported Frameworks & Stacks
- Node.js (Next.js, Vite, React, Express, Fastify, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Astro, Remix)
- Python (Flask, Django, FastAPI)
- Static HTML / Web sites
